onboarding.title: Nutrition Profile Setup
onboarding.whyWeNeedThisText: AI uses your data to create the safest and most effective nutrition and workout roadmap tailored to your health goals.

step1.title: Your Body Metrics
step1.description: Please provide accurate information so AI can calculate your BMI and daily nutritional needs specifically for you.

step2.title: What is your main health goal?
step2.description: Our AI will adjust your nutrition and workout plan based on what you want to achieve.

goals.weightLoss: Focus on calorie deficit, fat-burning exercises, and sustainable eating habits.
goals.muscleGain: Training plans focused on muscle hypertrophy and high-protein meal recommendations.
goals.maintenance: Balanced approach to keep your body active and optimize nutrition.
goals.heartHealth: Enhance endurance, cardiovascular health, and flexibility through aerobic activities.
goals.flexibility: Improve flexibility, reduce muscle tension, and increase body mobility.
goals.endurance: Enhance stamina, improve fitness, and long-term activity capacity.

step3.title: What is your usual activity level?
step3.description: Activity level helps us accurately calculate how many calories you burn each day.

step4.title: Your dietary preferences
step4.description: To help AI design the most suitable menu, please share with us your eating habits and restrictions.
step4.allergiesSubtitle: Select foods you are allergic to or intolerant of:

dietDescriptions.vegetarian: No meat or fish, includes eggs and dairy

step5.title: Do you have any health conditions to note?
step5.description: AI will use this information to adjust workout intensity and menu, ensuring absolute safety for you.
